verdict.rationale: Make documents a resource-oriented REST API with token auth and scopes, OAuth 2.0 flows (confidential and PKCE), broad endpoint references (connections, data stores, audit logs, analytics, AI agents), a troubleshooting section, a TypeScript SDK, and an llms.txt index for AI consumption. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and some endpoints that are beta- or Enterprise-gated.
